title: Subtitles: always embed English (soft) + default-on forced burn toggle
description: Per the user's subtitle decision: (1) auto-select/embed the disc's English subtitle track(s) as soft selectable tracks (off by default); (2) add a disc-level 'Burn forced subtitles' checkbox, default ON, that runs Foreign Audio Search and burns forced foreign-dialogue subs into the picture. Unchecking skips the slow scan pre-pass for plain-English discs (English still embedded). Threads burn_forced through models.RipRequest, presets.build_handbrake_args, ripper.enqueue/_run_job, main.api_rip; frontend auto-checks English sub boxes + adds the checkbox to the payload.

title: Switch default codec to H.264 (x264 / nvenc_h264)
description: User's Plex clients are an Android phone + two Chromecasts, which transcode HEVC. Switch both encoder modes from H.265 to H.264 for universal direct-play. Quality=x264 CRF20 slow (drop grain tune), Speed=nvenc_h264 CQ22 slow. Update presets.py, models.py enum comments, index.html toggle labels, tests, README 'why these defaults', CLAUDE.md module map.

title: Surface HandBrake error output on job failure
description: ripper.py merges stderr into stdout then drops every non-progress line, so a failed rip shows only 'HandBrakeCLI exited with code N' with no cause (disk full, CSS decryption failure, no audio track all look identical). Fix: collect the last ~25 non-progress output lines in a ring buffer and append them to the FAILED job's error field for diagnosability. Also bump chunk read 256->4096 to cut syscall rate.

title: Audio: emit AAC stereo + original surround passthrough per track
description: presets.py downmixes every selected audio track to stereo AAC only (--aencoder ca_aac + --mixdown stereo), permanently losing 5.1 surround on every rip — contradicting the docstring's stated 'AAC stereo + AC3 5.1 passthrough'. Fix: for each selected source track, emit two output tracks — ca_aac/stereo (universal compatibility default) and copy/none (passthrough of original AC3/DTS, falling back to ac3). Update test_presets.py assertions.

title: make restart: guard against killing active jobs
description: Current 'make restart' silently kills any running HandBrake job. Add a check: if container is up and /api/jobs reports any running/queued jobs, print a warning + prompt to confirm. FORCE=1 skips the prompt. Same guard for any make target that runs 'compose down' on a running app.

title: _cleanup_partial: unlink on cancel/fail unconditionally
description: Current logic only deletes 0-byte files, leaving multi-hundred-MB unplayable MP4s from cancelled/failed rips (HandBrake never finalizes the moov atom on non-zero exit, so the partial is useless). Change to delete the output file whenever HandBrake exits non-zero, regardless of size.

title: Progress bar stuck at 0% during rip
description: Job runs and output file grows, but UI shows 0%. Cause: HandBrakeCLI emits the 'Encoding: task X of Y, P.PP %' progress lines terminated with \r (carriage return) so they overwrite themselves in a terminal. proc.stdout.readline() blocks waiting for \n, never returning during encoding. Fix: read raw chunks and split on either \r or \n.
close_reason: Fixed: _consume_progress now reads raw chunks and splits on \r or \n; live in container; verified live progress updates work

title: Parse disc label for season/disc/vol; strip noise from prefill
description: DVD disc labels like 'PTELLER_S4_D1' need parsing. Extract season from S\d+/SEASON_\d+/SE\d+, disc from D\d+/DISC_\d+, volume from VOL_\d+. Return clean label + parsed numbers + isLikelyTV flag. Frontend: on scan, set content_type=tv if season found, populate season field from parsed value, use stripped label for search prefill.

title: Move season selector out of manual-entry block
description: Currently #tv-season lives inside #manual-tv which is hidden during TMDB search flow — user picks a show from search results but never sees the season input, so it stays at 1 even for a season-4 disc. Move season + starting-episode into an always-visible #tv-disc-info block shown whenever content_type=tv.

title: Unified search result + OMDb fallback in /api/search
description: Replace TMDB-specific result types with a unified SearchResult that has a 'source' field. /api/search tries TMDB first; if empty AND OMDb is enabled, calls OMDb. Response includes top-level 'source' indicator and per-result source. Episode lookup stays TMDB-only (OMDb picks skip auto-fill of episode titles).

close_reason: Deferred: user wants search-UX improvements first; OMDb not needed since both Bullshit! and other typical titles are already in TMDB

title: Eject fails with 'device busy' when host auto-mounts disc
description: User reports clicking Eject in UI fails with 'eject failed: device /dev/sr0 busy', but physical eject button works. Cause: GNOME/udisks2 auto-mounts the DVD on the host when inserted; the container's eject tries the kernel eject ioctl which fails with EBUSY because the host has the device mounted. Fix: fall back to 'eject -s' (SCSI direct command) which tells the drive's firmware to open the tray regardless of mount state (equivalent to the physical button).

title: Config: TMDB_API_KEY plumbing
description: docker-compose passes TMDB_API_KEY env var; Makefile passes from shell env (no default); Dockerfile declares empty default; requirements.txt adds httpx; README has setup section linking to themoviedb.org API key registration.

title: Ripper uses Plex path builder

title: TMDB async client (app/tmdb.py)

title: Extend models for content type + metadata
description: Add ContentType enum (MOVIE/TV), MovieMetadata (title, year), TVMetadata (show, season). Extend TitleSelection with episode_number and part_index. Extend RipRequest with content_type + movie_metadata or tv_metadata. Per-title episode_title optional for future use.

title: API endpoints: /api/search and TMDB lookups
description: GET /api/search?type=movie|tv&query=... -> top 5 results with id/title/year/poster. GET /api/tv/{tv_id}/seasons/{season}/episodes -> episode list. Update POST /api/rip to accept new metadata shape and pass through to ripper.

title: Plex output path builder (app/paths.py)
description: New module that takes content_type + metadata and returns the output Path. Movies: <root>/Movies/<Title> (<Year>)/<Title> (<Year>).mp4 with optional - cd<N> suffix for multi-part. TV: <root>/TV Shows/<Show>/Season <NN>/<Show> S<NN>E<NN>.mp4. Sanitize titles for filesystem (strip /:?*, etc.). Matches user's existing Deadwood layout.

title: Drop root in container, fix host file ownership
description: Container currently runs as root, so files in OUTPUT_DIR land as root:root and host user needs sudo to manage them. Add entrypoint that: (1) reads PUID/PGID env (default to caller's uid/gid via Makefile), (2) creates/updates an 'app' user with those ids, (3) joins the container user to a group matching the host cdrom GID so /dev/sr0 is readable, (4) chowns /output and /app if needed, (5) drops privileges via gosu before exec'ing uvicorn. Update docker-compose.yml, Makefile defaults (PUID=$(id -u), PGID=$(id -g), CDROM_GID from getent), and README troubleshooting.

title: Implement app/main.py: FastAPI routes
description: Routes: GET / (HTMX page), GET /api/scan, POST /api/rip, GET /api/jobs, GET /api/jobs/{id}/progress (SSE), POST /api/jobs/{id}/cancel, POST /api/eject. Pydantic models in app/models.py for request/response payloads.

title: Implement app/ripper.py: job queue + progress tracking
description: Asyncio-based job queue, runs one HandBrake job at a time. Spawn HandBrakeCLI subprocess, parse progress percent from stdout. Publish to asyncio.Queue per job for SSE consumption. States: queued/running/done/failed/cancelled. On completion write MP4 to /output/<DVD_LABEL>/title_<NN>_<descriptor>.mp4. Support cancel via process termination.

title: Implement app/presets.py: HandBrake encoder presets

Both: ca_aac+ac3 audio, decomb deinterlace, auto crop, anamorphic auto, chapter markers, MP4 with faststart, scan-burn forced subs, soft-include all other subs. Return argv list given (title_index, audio_tracks, subtitle_tracks, encoder_mode, output_path, device).

title: TMDB API key leaks into container logs
description: From code/security review (deferred). httpx logs the full request URL incl. ?api_key=... at INFO on every TMDB call, and embeds it in HTTPStatusError messages on 4xx/5xx. Fix: pass the key as a Bearer Authorization header instead of a query param (TMDB v3 supports it); httpx never logs headers. One-line change in TMDBClient.__init__ + drop api_key from params dicts.

title: Cancel robustness: track intent flag, fix SIGTERM exit-code race
description: From code review (deferred). cancel() on a running job relies on rc<0 or job-status to classify; if HandBrake exits non-negative on SIGTERM a cancel can be mislabeled FAILED, and a cancel during the create_subprocess_exec spawn window may not kill the process. Fix: a self._cancelling set[str] set in cancel() (also set status CANCELLED immediately for snappy UI), checked in _run_job to disambiguate, and re-checked right after spawn to kill if cancelled mid-spawn.

title: Cache-bust static assets to avoid stale JS/CSS after rebuild

Add a per-container-start version token to the FastAPI app and append ?v=<token> to static asset URLs in the template, so each new container forces a fresh fetch.

title: README with run instructions
description: How to build and run with docker compose, where to set OUTPUT_DIR, how to use the web UI, troubleshooting libdvdcss / device permissions / Nvidia container toolkit.

value: Never run 'make restart', 'make down', or 'make build && make restart' in this project while a HandBrake job is running/queued — it kills the worker and leaves a partial MP4 in OUTPUT_DIR. Always check curl http://localhost:8000/api/jobs first; if status=running or queued, ask the user before proceeding. The Makefile 'check-no-active-jobs' target enforces this with FORCE=1 override.

Subtitle preference for dvd-rip: use the DISC's own subtitle tracks, NOT Plex's downloaded/text subtitles. User has had accuracy problems with Plex-downloaded subs (wrong timing/version). So: embed the disc's English subtitle track (soft/selectable) and burn forced subs from the disc. Accept that disc subs are bitmap (VOBSUB) so enabling them on Chromecast triggers a Plex burn-transcode — accuracy is worth it to the user.

UI preferences for dvd-rip project: (1) clean/utility design, NOT decorated (user pushed back on eyebrow labels, brand marks, italic flourishes, grain textures, colophons as 'trying too hard to be fancy'); (2) cool blue-gray palette over warm/brown (panels #161922, body #0c0e13, text #e1e5ed); (3) Prussian Ink accent #4b73b8 — muted blue, not bright; (4) IBM Plex Sans/Mono only (no Fraunces or other display serifs). When iterating: keep typography distinctive but restrained, accent used sparingly on functional elements only (toggles, progress, focus rings).
